data_provenance: Synthetic prescribed gradients; no model training or performance benchmark.
definition: All states initially zero. AdaGrad sum += g*g. Uncentred RMSProp v=beta2*v+(1-beta2)*g*g; no momentum or bias correction. Adam m=beta1*m+(1-beta1)*g; v as above; mhat=m/(1-beta1**t); vhat=v/(1-beta2**t). All denominators sqrt(state)+epsilon; no decay, regularisation, clipping, AMSGrad or AdamW. Parameter change is signed -eta*numerator/denominator.
checks: independent closed-form first and second updates
Adam bias correction and sign persistence
